descriptions.text: The crypto community went into another frenzy last night, as Andre Cronje's unreleased project became the focus of hundreds of users, who bought $15 million of the $EMN token.

According to bluekirbyfi twitter messages, yearn. Finance founder Andre Cronje, launched the game project Eminence (EMN) encounter a flash loan attack, hackers will return $8 million of funds to the yearn deployer contracts.

On September 29, 2020, unreleased Eminence contracts on Ethereum were exploited, draining ~$15M from users who interacted with unaudited bonding-curve code. The attacker later returned $8M, and partial compensation was distributed, but $7M remains unrecovered. The Eminence pre-production bonding-curve contracts allowed recursive mint-burn cycles that could be manipulated by flash-loan-funded transactions to extract more value than deposited. This logic error was deployed unaudited to mainnet, allowing public access and catastrophic fund loss.
